title: 헌법재판소 정보화심의위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Meetings)
(1) The Committee may be convened by the Chairperson whenever necessary.
(2) A resolution of the Committee shall require the attendance of a majority of all incumbent members and the affirmative vote of a majority of members present; in the event of a tie, the Chairperson shall have the casting vote.
(3) The Committee shall record a summary of the results of each meeting in the minutes, which shall be signed by the Chairperson and a secretary.
(4) Where it is difficult to convene a meeting or the matter is minor, deliberation may be conducted in writing. <Newly Inserted on March 22, 2021>
